newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Tutu says prostate cancer has spread.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Tutu says prostate cancer has spread.

text.p: South African Nobel peace laureate Desmond Tutu said on Wednesday his prostate cancer had spread and he would be treated with a combination of radiation and hormone therapy.
Tutu, a leading campaigner in the fight against apartheid, said in a statement that he would go to the United States for two months later this year for the radiation therapy.
"I have been advised that the cancer is suspected to have penetrated beyond the prostate gland and that as a result radiotherapy is the best option," he said.

"Medical specialists in Cape Town will begin a three-month course of hormone treatment tomorrow (Thursday)...After the hormone treatment, I plan to have the radio therapy at a clinic in the United States."
